summary: Phase 12 regression sweep — UI verification of 5 bug fixes against the deployed preview URL as alice. All 5 fixes verified present in code (grep) AND exercised through the UI where possible: (1) jump-to-reply handler in ChatPanel.jsx L180-212 uses requestAnimationFrame waitRender + 6-iteration loadOlderMessages backfill; live test clicked 3 visible reply-quotes and the pinned-messages banner — NO 'Message not in view' toast appeared (toast text empty); /api/messages backfill was not needed since targets already in DOM (happy-path). (2) Tap-bubble-opens-menu: clicking the inner bubble div in Bob DM opens the dropdown menu — Reply/Forward/Pin/Copy/Edit/Delete items rendered, msg-action-reply visible=true; ⋯ trigger confirmed as w-0 h-0 absolute hidden button at MessageBubble.jsx L344-351 — left-click on bubble div fires setMenuOpen(true) via the new onClick at L237-242 with lp.didFire() guard. (3) Channel admin promote: handlePromote at ChannelInfoDialog.jsx L58 → promoteChannelAdmin at messenger.jsx L668 → POST /api/channels/{id}/admins/{uid} — wiring confirmed via grep. P12 Channel has only Alice (owner) + Bob (already ADMIN) so no non-admin members to click; TestChannel has 0 non-admins too. Wiring is verified but no live POST observed in this run because all members are already admin. (4) Mute toggle: clicking the Mute button in P12 Channel info dialog fired POST /api/conversations/{id}/mute → 200 OK on the network log (verified). (5) No online-dot in channel/group headers: walked 10 sidebar conversations — 0/5 channels+groups showed chat-header-online-dot; the single DM (Bob) DID show the dot, confirming the !isChannel && !isGroup guard at ChatPanel.jsx L399-403 works correctly.
action_items: Optional: To live-exercise Test 3 (promote POST) the main agent (or a follow-up test) can first demote Bob in P12 Channel then re-promote — but the wiring is correctly in place and identical in pattern to the mute toggle (which was observed firing a real network call successfully in this run). No code change required.

Optional: Test 1 backfill loop (loadOlderMessages × up to 6) was not exercised because all visible reply-targets were already in DOM. To force-exercise it, seed a reply that points to a message >50 entries back. Wiring with waitRender (double-rAF) is verified on disk and the negative-path (no false 'Message not in view' toast) was confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatPanel.jsx L180-212: handleJumpToReply correctly awaits requestAnimationFrame twice (double-rAF) before re-querying DOM after loadOlderMessages — the canonical fix for the React-render race.
MessageBubble.jsx L237-242: onClick uses lp.didFire?.() guard so long-press (multi-select entry) doesn't double-fire as a single-tap open-menu. Correct.
MessageBubble.jsx L344-351: ⋯ trigger now opacity-0 pointer-events-none p-0 w-0 h-0 — effectively invisible but still anchors the dropdown via Radix asChild trigger. Correct.
ChatPanel.jsx L399-403: !isChannel && !isGroup guard correctly suppresses OnlineDot in channel/group headers.
ChannelInfoDialog.jsx L58: handlePromote → promoteChannelAdmin(convId, uid) → refreshMembers; messenger.jsx L668 POSTs /api/channels/{id}/admins/{uid}. Wiring chain intact.

success_rate.frontend: 5/5 fixes verified in code + 4/5 exercised live in UI (test 3 promote could not be exercised because Bob already admin in available channels; mute POST observed succeeding via same pattern). No regressions found.

seed_data_creation: None new in this iteration; existing seed conversations and prior-iteration messages were reused.
